verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs index lists SDKs as part of its developer offering (box-probe-1), and an official SDK repo exists under the box GitHub org (box-gh-1). However, that repo carries a deprecation notice saying it will get no new features, fixes, or security patches, and the pack names no actively maintained successor. missing for 10: documented actively maintained official SDKs, SDK language coverage and install/usage docs, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
